The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' item is part of the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is obtainable through the [[Donkey|donkey's]] questline. 

It is a quest item, and will only be provided 2 by the [[Donkey|donkey]] along with the [[Revolutionary message 2]]. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' item provides the base item for creating [[Donkey combat equipment]], which is created by [[Krezvold]] when given some money. You obtain after sometime, a {{Item|Battle horseshoes|1}} and {{Item|Iron unicorn horns|1}}.
